caption: The drawing depicts two rectangular textile patterns on a plain, off-white background. The larger rectangle is positioned in the upper center portion of the page and features a series of vertical bands composed of repeating decorative motifs and geometric or floral patterns. The bands are colored predominantly in shades of blue, red, orange, and white. Some of the bands have diamond or geometric designs, while others feature scrolling, leaf, or floral shapes. In one blue band, there are horizontal white rectangles with capitalized white text, some in reverse writing, reading phrases such as "FLORENCE MILTO" and other partially legible words. The colors in the bands alternate, with narrower strips separating the wider, more ornate sections. Below and to the right of the main rectangle is a smaller rectangular sample, displaying a similar decorative pattern featuring a large leaf-like motif and swirling shapes in blue, turquoise, white, and red hues. Both patterns have a highly textured appearance, mimicking the look of embroidered or woven fabric. The label "FLORENCE MILTO" is printed in small, fine letters to the left beneath the large rectangle.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
